page.layout: One page: a parchment wrapper or cover leaf with handwriting only. No printed text blocks, no margins with print.
page.notes: No printed text on this page. The upper part carries a manuscript ownership inscription in brown ink, partly illegible: a shelf or folio-style note at the top ("...86 ... obvic ... 7 ...") and below it the owner's name, apparently "Sum Conradi Kolcuträgeri Agiensis" (the name and place are only partly legible). This is handwriting, not print, so it is left out of the transcription. The lower right has a library shelf mark ("XX 33473" in pencil or ink), which is also not transcribed. Show-through and stains are not transcribed.
